## Problem

<!--
What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the user or developer problem, not just the feature you want.
-->

## Proposed solution

<!--
Describe the behavior or feature you would like to see.
-->

## Use case

<!--
Explain who would benefit from this and how it would be used.
Provide a concrete example when possible.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
What alternatives, workarounds, or existing approaches have you considered?
Why are they insufficient?
-->

## Additional context

<!--
Add mockups, examples, related issues, links, technical considerations,

-->

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and did not find a duplicate.
- [ ] I have explained the problem this feature would solve.
- [ ] I have described the proposed behavior clearly.
- [ ] I have considered existing alternatives or workarounds.
- [ ] This request is not a security vulnerability.
- [ ] I have read and agree to follow the project's Code of Conduct.
